subject: Silver Shield
text: Buying the Silver Shield only triggers the achievement if you are holding the Large Shield.

evidence.quote: You have to buy the Silver Shield while you are holding the Large Shield or the achievement does not pop.

subject: Dragonlord's offer
text: The default choice for the Dragonlord's offer is yes, and mashing A to start the fight can accept it by accident.

evidence.quote: why is "yes" the default option......was mashing A to start the fight and lost like 3 hours of grinding lmao.

subject: Gwaelin
object: underground cave that connects the two continents
text: Gwaelin is in the underground cave that connects the two continents.

evidence.quote: The princess is on the underground cave that connects the two continents

subject: Gwaelin
text: Do not go to Gwaelin in the cave, because nothing from her is needed to finish the game.

evidence.quote: just don't ever go to where Gwaelin is in the cave. You don't get anything from her that's strictly necessary to complete the game.

subject: Gwaelin
text: Once Gwaelin has been rescued, the Dragonlord-without-Gwaelin achievement can only be earned by starting a new game.

evidence.quote: If you've rescued her already, you'll need to start a brand new game.

subject: Gwaelin rescue timing
text: Rescuing Gwaelin right after getting the Magic Key forces a return to the castle, because a plot item is locked behind a door.

evidence.quote: if you save her right after getting the magic key you will be forced to go back to the castle because a plot required item is locked behind a door too.

subject: Dragonlord
text: A commenter suggests saving just before the final boss, beating the game to get this achievement, then reloading to earn the other two.

evidence.quote: I assume you can "save" just before the final boss without ever saving her. Beat the game, get this achievement, reload and then get the other two.

subject: Gwaelin
text: A commenter reported the achievement unlocked wrongly after rescuing the princess, beating the Dragonlord, and walking back to the king with her.

evidence.quote: This unlocked wrong for me. I rescued Princess on way to Dragonlord, fought and beat Dragonlord, then walked back to king with Princess.

subject: Gwaelin
text: A developer fix stopped the achievement from triggering while the player carries the princess back to the king.

evidence.quote: Just a small fix to prevent it from triggering while carrying the princess back to the king.

subject: second playthrough
text: A commenter estimates the game takes no more than 8 hours on a second playthrough.

evidence.quote: shouldn't take more than 8 hours the second time.
